job.title: Temp HR Advisor
job.description:
Job Description:

An exciting opportunity has arisen for an experienced HR professional to join a growing organisation on an urgent temporary basis. This role will have a strong focus on employee relations, supporting managers with a varied and high-volume caseload across the business.

This is a temporary role lasting around 5/6 weeks, with the potential for extension, and offers excellent flexibility around both working hours and location.

The Role

Working as part of a busy HR team, you will provide hands-on support across a wide range of employee relations matters and wider HR activities, including:

  • Managing a high volume of employee relations casework from initial query through to resolution
  • Advising and coaching managers on UK employment law, internal policies and HR best practice
  • Managing disciplinary and grievance cases, including supporting investigations and formal meetings
  • Supporting managers with performance and capability matters
  • Managing short and long-term absence cases and advising on appropriate next steps
  • Providing guidance on a range of day-to-day employee relations queries
  • Producing and reviewing relevant ER documentation and correspondence
  • Supporting wider HR projects and organisational change activity where required
  • Providing additional support around TUPE activity where needed

This is a hands-on role where you will be trusted to take ownership of your own caseload, provide pragmatic advice to managers and confidently manage a variety of employee relations matters.

About You

  • Previous experience working as an HR Advisor, HR Generalist, Employee Relations Advisor or HR Business Partner
  • Strong hands-on experience managing employee relations casework
  • Confident handling disciplinary, grievance, absence, performance and capability matters
  • Strong understanding of UK employment law and HR best practice
  • Comfortable managing a high-volume and varied caseload independently
  • Confident advising and coaching managers through employee relations processes
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to build relationships at all levels
  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills
  • Able to work independently and manage competing priorities effectively
  • Available to start at short notice or immediately preferred
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving business environment with plenty of variety and autonomy

Hours & Flexibility

The business offers a highly flexible approach to working hours and location. Typical working patterns could include:

  • 8:00am – 4:00pm
  • 8:30am – 4:30pm
  • 9:00am – 5:00pm

Lunch breaks can be taken to suit your preference, whether that's 30 minutes, 45 minutes or an hour.

There is also significant flexibility around home working, with employees welcome to work from home as much as required.

Salary: £38,000–£40,000 DOE FTE

Location: LS15 offices / hybrid working

Start date: Immediate start to last around 5/6 weeks, potential to extend

If you're an experienced HR professional with strong employee relations experience, available at short notice and looking for a hands-on contract role with plenty of autonomy, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today for a confidential discussion.

INDMAN

job.title: Senior Commercial Finance Analyst
job.description:
I’m working with a large international professional services organisation to recruit a Senior Commercial Finance Analyst into its established finance team in Leeds. This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys the analytical and commercial side of finance – working with data, understanding what the numbers are telling you and then being able to communicate that clearly to stakeholders across the business. You don’t necessarily need to be fully qualified. You may be part-qualified ACCA/CIMA or have developed strong commercial finance experience without following the professional qualification route.

What you will need is excellent Excel. This is a role for someone who genuinely enjoys working with spreadsheets and large volumes of financial data. You’ll be confident with PivotTables, VLOOKUPs/XLOOKUPs, formulas and manipulating and analysing data. Power BI experience would be a definite advantage as you will work with this daily.

The role

Working as part of a sizeable commercial finance function, you’ll:

  • Analyse financial and commercial performance, including P&L and key performance indicators (KPIs)
  • Produce regular reporting and analysis, identifying trends and areas requiring further investigation
  • Work extensively with Excel and large datasets to interrogate and interpret financial information
  • Turn financial information into clear, useful commercial insight
  • Support stakeholders in understanding performance and the key drivers behind the numbers
  • Provide analysis to support commercial and business decision-making
  • Work with stakeholders across different areas and international locations
  • Manage a busy workload where priorities can change quickly
  • Build strong relationships with both finance and non-finance colleagues
  • Contribute to improving reporting, processes and the way financial information is used across the business

What we're looking for

You’ll ideally have:

  • Previous experience within commercial finance, financial analysis or a similar analytical finance role
  • Good understanding of P&L, KPIs and commercial performance
  • Advanced Excel skills – this is essential
  • Strong analytical ability and confidence working with significant volumes of data
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain financial information clearly
  • A proactive and responsive approach to your workload
  • Experience working in a busy, commercially focused environment
  • Power BI experience would be highly desirable as it will be used daily
  • SAP experience would ideal

Experience within a law firm would be particularly attractive, although candidates from other professional services or larger/international organisations will also be considered.

You could be part-qualified ACCA/CIMA, or qualified by experience with a strong track record in relevant finance roles.

What's on offer?

This is a high-expectation environment, but one where people are supported, developed and recognised for doing a good job. There is genuine opportunity to progress as you develop within the team.

The role is Monday to Friday, 9am–5pm (35 hours per week), with a hybrid working pattern of three days in the Leeds office and two days from home.

Salary will depend on experience and qualification level, with scope to approximately £50,000 for the right candidate, plus benefits and the potential for a discretionary bonus.

If you enjoy finance but particularly love the commercial analysis, P&L, KPI, data and Excel side of your role, I’d be very interested in speaking with you.

Location: Leeds city centre
Job Type: Permanent, Full Time

job.title: Group Financial Accountant - 12 month ftc
job.description:
I’m working with a large international professional services organisation to recruit a Group Financial Accountant to join its established finance team in Leeds on a 12-month fixed-term contract. This is a group-level role with an international focus, combining financial control, balance sheet responsibility, payroll accounting and stakeholder management. You’ll also lead a team of five accountants, so it would suit someone who enjoys taking ownership while still remaining hands-on with the numbers.

Payroll accounting is a particularly important part of the role. You’ll be responsible for monthly payroll postings and balance sheets, analysing payroll and headcount costs against budget and communicating the key variances and insights to senior stakeholders.

ACA, ACCA or CIMA qualification would be preferred, although we will also consider candidates who are qualified by experience where they can demonstrate strong payroll accounting experience.

The role

Working within the Group Finance team, you’ll:

  • Take ownership of monthly payroll postings into the management accounts
  • Work closely with the payroll team to ensure costs are correctly allocated across countries and business areas
  • Analyse monthly payroll and headcount costs, identifying and explaining key variances against budget
  • Present monthly reporting and analysis to senior stakeholders and other teams across the business
  • Take responsibility for payroll and accounts payable balance sheets
  • Coordinate the monthly balance sheet process, collating information from across the team and ensuring files are prepared to a high standard for review
  • Prepare quarterly consolidated balance sheet information for the treasury team
  • Act as a key point of contact for international finance teams
  • Support the UK external audit, particularly in relation to payroll
  • Take ownership of statutory reporting relating to payment practices and performance
  • Lead and support a team of five accountants
  • Identify opportunities to improve processes, controls and efficiency
  • Support wider Group Finance projects as required

What we're looking for

You’ll ideally have:

  • ACA, ACCA or CIMA qualification, although strong QBE candidates will also be considered
  • Strong financial accounting and financial control experience
  • Good technical accounting knowledge, including FRS 102
  • Experience of balance sheet ownership and reconciliations
  • Payroll accounting experience, particularly payroll postings, reconciliations and analysis
  • Experience analysing payroll/headcount costs and explaining variances
  • Previous experience managing or leading a finance team
  • Strong stakeholder management skills and confidence communicating financial information to senior colleagues
  • Experience working across multiple entities, business areas or locations
  • Excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage competing deadlines

Previous experience within an LLP or law firm would be particularly attractive, as would experience within an international or group finance environment. However, candidates from other professional services or larger, complex organisations will also be considered.

For candidates who are qualified by experience rather than professionally qualified, strong hands-on payroll accounting experience will be particularly important.

What's on offer?

This is an opportunity to join a sizeable international organisation in a Group Finance position offering exposure across financial control, payroll, reporting, audit and international finance.

The role is a 12-month fixed-term contract and offers hybrid working, with three days per week in the Leeds office. 

Salary is up to approximately £45,000, depending on experience, plus benefits.

If you’re a Financial Accountant, Group Accountant or Finance Manager who enjoys financial control but also likes analysing the numbers and working with people across a business, I’d be very interested in speaking with you.

Location: Leeds

Job Type: Full Time, 12 Month Fixed-Term Contract

job.title: Customer Host / Front of House

Salary: £27,500

We are exclusively working with a growing organisation to recruit a Customer Host / Front of House position, working across two locations in LS15 and Harrogate.

 

This is a varied, people-focused role combining front of house, customer service, hospitality and general operational support. You’ll be responsible for providing a warm and professional welcome to customers and visitors, while helping to ensure both locations run smoothly and are consistently presented to a high standard.

 

This would be a great opportunity for someone from a customer service, hospitality, retail or reception background who has extensive experience working in this field who enjoys working with people and is happy getting involved in a range of different responsibilities throughout the day.

 

What will you be doing?

  • Meeting and greeting customers and visitors, providing excellent customer service.
  • Acting as a friendly and approachable point of contact for day-to-day queries.
  • Managing meeting room bookings and ensuring rooms are prepared and ready for use.
  • Assisting with post, deliveries and general customer requests.
  • Preparing refreshments and ensuring kitchen and refreshment areas remain clean, tidy and well stocked.
  • Supporting with catering and the set-up of meetings and events.
  • Ensuring reception, meeting rooms and communal areas are consistently well presented.
  • Carrying out regular checks throughout the day and resolving any presentation or cleanliness issues.
  • Supporting with general upkeep and reporting any maintenance requirements.
  • Completing routine health, safety and compliance checks.
  • Monitoring and replenishing stock and supplies.
  • Providing general administrative support, including data entry and maintaining records.
  • Working closely with the wider team to ensure the smooth day-to-day running of both locations.

 

What are we looking for?

  • Previous experience within customer service, hospitality, retail, reception or administration would be beneficial.
  • A confident and friendly communicator who enjoys interacting with people.
  • Professional, approachable and well presented.
  • Strong attention to detail with high standards of presentation.
  • Organised and able to manage several tasks at once.
  • Proactive with a willingness to get involved and help wherever needed.
  • Comfortable working in a hands-on role rather than being solely desk based.
  • Reliable, motivated and able to work both independently and as part of a team.
  • Comfortable travelling between the LS15 and Harrogate locations.

 

This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking for a varied, customer-focused position within a growing organisation

job.title: Customer Host
job.description:
Job Title: Customer Host 
Location: Harrogate
Salary: National Minimum Wage, dependent on age
Hours: Monday – Friday, 8:00am – 4:30pm
Benefits: Onsite parking | Birthday holiday after 1 year's service | Excellent progression opportunities

We are exclusively recruiting for a friendly and growing business in Harrogate who are looking for a personable and proactive Customer Host to join their team.

This is a brilliant opportunity for someone currently working within hospitality, retail, hotels, leisure or another customer-facing environment who would love to move into an office-based Monday–Friday role while still using their people skills.

You don't necessarily need previous office experience. We're looking for someone who is naturally warm, organised and helpful, takes real pride in maintaining a clean, welcoming and well-presented environment and isn't afraid to get stuck in.

There are also lots of opportunities to learn, develop and progress within the business, making this a great role for someone looking to build a longer-term career.

As Customer Host, you'll play a key part in making sure everyone coming into the workplace receives a fantastic experience. This is a varied and hands-on position combining customer service, hospitality, cleaning and general upkeep of the environment.

Your day will include:

  • Welcoming customers and visitors and providing friendly, professional support
  • Building great relationships and being a visible, approachable presence
  • Cleaning and maintaining communal areas throughout the day, including reception areas, kitchens, bathrooms, meeting rooms and refreshment areas
  • Carrying out regular cleaning and presentation checks, completing touch-ups and ensuring all areas remain clean, tidy and welcoming
  • Restocking bathrooms, kitchens and refreshment areas
  • Preparing fresh coffee and ensuring tea and coffee stations are clean and fully stocked
  • Helping with catering and setting up and clearing down rooms for meetings and events

What we're looking for

Previous experience within hospitality, retail, hotels, leisure or customer service would be ideal, but personality and attitude are really important for this role.

You'll be someone who is:

  • Friendly, confident and comfortable speaking to lots of different people
  • Naturally helpful with a genuine passion for providing great service
  • Happy to undertake cleaning and general upkeep as a key part of the role
  • Proactive and happy to spot what needs doing without always being asked
  • Organised and able to juggle different tasks throughout the day
  • Particular about cleanliness, presentation and maintaining high standards
  • Reliable, hardworking and happy to get stuck in

This would particularly suit someone who loves the customer-facing side of hospitality or retail but is looking for more sociable Monday–Friday working hours and the opportunity to move into an office-based career.

You'll be joining a genuinely friendly company where people are encouraged to develop, take on more responsibility and progress as the business continues to grow.

Monday – Friday, 8:00am – 4:30pm
Harrogate
Onsite parking available

job.title: Digital Conent Creator
job.description:
Location: LS15, Leeds
Salary: £28,000–£34,000, depending on experience
Working Pattern: Full-time, Monday–Friday
Working Style: Fully onsite initially, with hybrid working available once fully established in the role

The Opportunity

We are exclusively recruiting for an exciting and growing business based in LS15 who are looking to appoint an experienced Digital Marketing & Content Executive.

This is a varied, hands-on marketing position with a strong focus on content creation, video, social media and lead generation. You’ll work closely with the Head of Marketing and wider teams to create engaging digital content that strengthens the brand, showcases customer stories and supports commercial growth.

This role would suit someone who is naturally creative but also commercially minded – someone who understands that great content should not only look good, but drive engagement, enquiries and results.

The Role

You’ll take ownership of a broad range of digital marketing and content activity, including:

  • Planning, filming and editing high-quality video content, including interviews, customer stories, tours and short-form social content
  • Creating engaging written and visual content for LinkedIn, YouTube, email, the website and wider digital campaigns
  • Managing organic and paid LinkedIn activity following an initial handover
  • Planning and maintaining the content calendar
  • Developing email campaigns, automated journeys and lead-nurture activity
  • Supporting targeted marketing and lead-generation campaigns
  • Producing brochures, case studies, proposals and other sales and marketing collateral
  • Working directly with customers to create testimonials, case studies and engaging customer-led content
  • Supporting the promotion and follow-up of company events
  • Coordinating marketing activity with internal teams and external agencies
  • Monitoring campaign performance and providing clear reporting and recommendations
  • Identifying new content opportunities and bringing fresh ideas to the wider marketing strategy

About You

Previous experience within digital marketing and content creation is essential for this position.

We are particularly interested in speaking with candidates who have hands-on experience creating content from concept through to delivery and are confident filming, editing and producing video for digital channels.

You will also need:

  • Strong knowledge of LinkedIn, social media management and content planning
  • Previous experience creating, filming and editing video content
  • Excellent copywriting and proofreading skills
  • Experience delivering email and digital marketing campaigns
  • Experience creating visual assets using Adobe Creative Suite, Canva or similar platforms
  • A good understanding of how digital marketing supports lead generation and wider business objectives
  • Confidence using performance data to improve marketing activity
  • Strong organisation and attention to detail
  • The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities
  • A proactive approach with the confidence to take ownership of your work
  • Strong communication skills and the confidence to engage directly with customers

The customer-facing element is particularly important. You’ll need to be comfortable approaching customers, conducting interviews and encouraging people to get involved in video content, testimonials and customer stories.

Experience with paid LinkedIn campaigns, HubSpot or another CRM, marketing automation, photography, SEO or B2B marketing would be advantageous.

Working Environment

The role will initially be fully onsite in LS15, allowing you to gain a thorough understanding of the business, its customers, teams and wider operation.

Once you are fully trained and established in the position, there will be the opportunity to move to a hybrid working arrangement.

Why Apply?

This is an excellent opportunity to join a growing business in a genuinely varied marketing role where you’ll have the opportunity to take ownership, contribute ideas and see the impact of your work.

You’ll have the freedom to create content from scratch, work directly with customers and collaborate with different areas of the business to deliver marketing activity that supports real commercial growth.

If you have strong digital marketing experience, a passion for content creation and the confidence to bring customer stories to life, we would love to hear from you.

job.title: Sales Manager
job.description:
Are you an ambitious sales leader who enjoys building teams, creating structure and turning growth plans into commercial results?

 

We’re recruiting on behalf of a fast-growing healthcare business looking for a Sales Manager to build and lead a new national outbound sales function.

 

This is a newly created role with genuine scope to shape the team from the ground up. You’ll recruit and develop Sales Representatives, introduce scalable sales processes and create a high-performance culture focused on customer acquisition, revenue growth and exceptional service.

It’s an excellent opportunity for a commercially driven, hands-on leader who wants the autonomy to create something new and make a visible impact.

 

The role

You’ll take ownership of an outbound sales function focused primarily on developing new business across the care home market, alongside supporting direct-to-patient services.

Working closely with field-based Territory Executives and wider operational teams, you’ll ensure opportunities are identified, developed and converted effectively, while delivering a seamless and compassionate experience for customers, patients and carers.

 

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Recruiting, leading and developing a high-performing outbound sales team
  • Creating the team structure, KPIs, coaching frameworks and performance standards
  • Developing and delivering sales campaigns across care home and direct-to-patient channels
  • Driving customer acquisition, conversion and revenue growth
  • Introducing effective prospecting and consultative-selling approaches
  • Building relationships with care home owners, managers and procurement teams
  • Working closely with field sales colleagues to generate qualified opportunities and maximise conversion
  • Improving CRM, telephony and sales processes to increase productivity and customer engagement
  • Monitoring pipeline health, forecasting, conversion rates and customer journeys
  • Using performance data and customer insight to identify areas for improvement and new commercial opportunities
  • Establishing reporting, governance and succession-planning frameworks to support the function’s long-term growth
  • Ensuring all activity meets the required regulatory, compliance and data-protection standards

 

About you

We’re looking for an energetic and commercially minded sales leader who can balance strategy with hands-on delivery.

You’ll ideally bring:

  • Proven experience leading an outbound sales, business development or contact-centre sales team
  • Experience building, launching or transforming a sales function
  • A strong record of delivering customer acquisition and revenue targets
  • The ability to create meaningful KPIs and manage pipeline, forecasting and conversion performance
  • Excellent coaching and people-development skills
  • Strong commercial judgment and a data-led approach to decision-making
  • Experience using CRM, telephony or customer-management platforms
  • The confidence to influence senior stakeholders and collaborate across departments
  • An entrepreneurial mindset and the ability to turn new ideas into commercial results
  • A customer-focused, consultative approach, particularly when dealing with sensitive or personal circumstances

 

What’s on offer

  • Competitive salary and bonus opportunity
  • The chance to build and shape a new national sales function
  • Genuine autonomy and visibility within a growing business
  • Ongoing training and professional development
  • 27 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, with the option to buy or sell additional days
  • Health cash plan and 24/7 GP service
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Life assurance and pension scheme
  • Paid volunteering days
  • A collaborative, energetic and values-led working environment

job.title: Property Project Manager
job.description:
The opportunity

This is an exciting opportunity to join an ambitious sports business at a key stage of its growth. Working as part of a small, fast-paced team, you will help identify new locations and then keep each project moving from initial opportunity through to opening. 

It is a varied, hands-on role for somebody who enjoys being out on site, building strong relationships and solving problems. You will coordinate multiple workstreams, maintain momentum and make sure the right people have the information and actions they need to deliver successful venues.

What you will be doing

  • Support the search for new locations by researching opportunities, reviewing potential sites and arranging or attending viewings.
  • Build relationships with commercial agents, landlords, developers, local partners and other contacts who can introduce suitable opportunities.
  • Complete initial site assessments, gathering the practical information needed to help the leadership team evaluate feasibility and commercial potential.
  • Coordinate activity from agreed site through design, planning, fit-out and opening, keeping programmes, actions and dependencies visible.
  • Visit sites regularly to monitor progress, identify issues early and ensure contractors, consultants and suppliers remain aligned to the plan.
  • Maintain clear project trackers covering milestones, budgets, risks, decisions and outstanding actions across several live projects.
  • Work closely with architects, planning advisers, contractors, utilities providers, equipment suppliers and internal colleagues.
  • Provide concise, practical updates to the leadership team and escalate risks with solutions and recommendations.
  • Support procurement, supplier coordination, documentation and handover so each venue is ready for a smooth launch.
  • Improve project processes and templates as the business grows, bringing structure without slowing down delivery.

What we are looking for

  • Experience coordinating property, construction, fit-out, facilities or multi-site opening projects; experience in leisure, hospitality, retail or sport would be particularly relevant.
  • A highly organised approach, with the ability to manage competing priorities and keep several projects progressing at once.
  • Commercial awareness and the confidence to assess opportunities, ask the right questions and challenge constructively.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to build effective relationships with senior colleagues, landlords, agents, contractors and suppliers.
  • A practical, proactive mindset: you notice what needs doing, take ownership and follow actions through to completion.
  • Comfort working with pace, ambiguity and changing priorities in an entrepreneurial, growing business.
  • Confidence using project plans, budgets, trackers and reporting tools to create clarity and accountability.
  • A full UK driving licence and willingness to travel regularly to current and prospective sites across the UK.

Why join?

  • Play a visible part in the expansion of one of the UK’s most exciting growth sports.
  • Join a close-knit, ambitious team where your ideas and contribution will be noticed.
  • Enjoy genuine variety across property, project delivery and commercial development.
  • Take ownership of projects and see the direct impact of your work as new venues open.
  • Build your career as the company, its estate and the role continue to grow.

job.title: Personal Tax Senior / Senior Tax Accountant
job.description:
Are you an experienced personal tax professional looking for a role where you can take ownership of your clients while still having the support of an experienced tax team around you?

We're working with a well-established independent accountancy practice in Leeds to recruit a Personal Tax Senior / Senior Tax Accountant.

We're deliberately keeping an open mind on job titles and qualifications. You might currently be working as a Personal Tax Senior, Tax Senior, Tax Adviser, Tax Accountant or Assistant Manager – or perhaps you're an experienced practice accountant whose role includes a significant amount of personal tax.

What matters most is that you have good hands-on personal tax experience gained within accountancy practice and are comfortable dealing directly with clients.

The Role

You'll take responsibility for a varied portfolio of personal tax clients, including individuals, company directors and clients of the wider accounts team.

A large part of the role is personal tax compliance. You'll manage the Self Assessment process from start to finish, obtaining information from clients, preparing accurate returns, dealing with queries and making sure deadlines are met.

You'll have support from experienced senior colleagues when you need it, while having the autonomy to manage your own clients and workload.

Depending on your existing experience, you'll also have the opportunity to become involved in trusts, estates, partnerships, Capital Gains Tax and more complex tax matters.

There is advisory work within the team too. You don't need to arrive as an advisory tax specialist – the important thing is having strong compliance foundations and the ability to recognise when a client's circumstances may require further tax advice.

Key Responsibilities

  • Managing your own portfolio of personal tax clients
  • Preparing and submitting Self Assessment tax returns
  • Taking ownership of the tax return process from start to finish
  • Liaising directly with clients and HMRC
  • Reviewing tax calculations, coding notices, statements and repayments
  • Dealing with Capital Gains Tax matters where appropriate
  • Preparing trust, estate and partnership returns depending on your experience
  • Identifying potential tax issues and opportunities for further advice
  • Working alongside the Tax Manager and Tax Partners on more complex matters
  • Building strong, long-term client relationships
  • Supporting more junior members of the team where appropriate
  • Managing deadlines and your own workload effectively
  • Assisting with new client onboarding and relevant AML requirements

Experience, Skill Set and/or Qualifications

We're interested in speaking to people with solid personal tax experience gained within an accountancy practice.

You don't necessarily need to be CTA qualified and we're not looking for somebody who already knows absolutely everything.

You could be a strong Personal Tax Senior looking for your next move, an experienced Tax Adviser wanting more responsibility, an Assistant Manager who still enjoys hands-on client work, or a practice accountant whose experience has included significant responsibility for personal tax.

Ideally, you'll have:

  • Several years' personal tax experience within accountancy practice
  • Good practical knowledge of Self Assessment and personal tax compliance
  • Experience managing your own clients or taking significant responsibility for a portfolio
  • Confidence communicating directly with clients
  • The ability to organise your workload and work to tax deadlines
  • A proactive and professional approach

Experience of trusts, estates, partnerships, CGT or tax planning would be useful, but we don't expect every candidate to have experience across every area.

ACA, ACCA, CTA, ATT or similar qualifications would be welcomed, but relevant practical experience is equally important.

What's on offer?

  • Salary up to £50,000 depending on experience
  • One day per week working from home
  • Free on-site parking
  • Established and supportive tax team
  • Direct client responsibility and genuine autonomy
  • Opportunity to broaden your technical tax experience
  • Exposure to advisory work alongside experienced Tax Managers and Partners
  • Ongoing professional development
  • Friendly, independent practice environment

Contract Information

  • Location: Leeds, within easy reach of the city centre
  • Job Type: Permanent, Full Time

If you've built good personal tax experience in practice but aren't sure whether you tick every box, we'd still be very happy to have a conversation.
